module.name: Clinical Agent Gateway
module.author: CERIST / CHU Blida neurosurgery project
module.description: Security and audit gateway between OpenMRS and an external conversational agent service. Relays chat turns, mints short-lived delegated tokens so every agent-originated call runs under the requesting clinician's own privileges, logs every such call append-only, and lets an administrator review and reverse one. Contains no clinical or department-specific logic and could be reused by an unrelated department unchanged.

privilege.name: App: agentgateway.chat.use
privilege.description: Able to open the clinical assistant and have read-only lookups run on their behalf

privilege.name: App: agentgateway.chat.write
privilege.description: Able to have a confirmed create/update/booking executed on their behalf through the assistant. An extra gate on top of the user's own clinical privileges, never a replacement for them

privilege.name: App: agentgateway.voice.use
privilege.description: Able to dictate into the assistant's chat box instead of typing. Separate from chat.use so dictation can be switched off without withdrawing the assistant. Confers only speech-to-text into the compose box; the text is then an ordinary chat turn

privilege.name: App: agentgateway.rollback
privilege.description: Able to review the assistant's operation log and attempt to reverse an operation. Administrators only

globalProperty.description: Base URL of the Clinical Agent Service on Server 2. Server-to-server only; never reachable from a browser.
Shared secret proving a relayed chat turn genuinely came from this OpenMRS instance. Must match AGENT_CHANNEL_SECRET on the agent service. The chat refuses to start while this is empty.
Connect/read timeout for the relay call to the agent service, in milliseconds.
Lifetime of a delegated token, in seconds. Keep it short: it is the window in which a leaked token could be replayed.

Comma-separated URI prefixes an agent-originated call may target. Anything outside this list is refused even with a valid token. Add /module/patientview/ here to let the assistant reach the neurosurgery-specific endpoints.
How this module reaches its own OpenMRS instance to read a record's before-state and to issue a reversing call. Should stay on the loopback interface.
Whether to read a record's current state back before the assistant overwrites it. Turning this off makes updates non-reversible, and the log says so.
Maximum characters of any single request/response body kept in the audit log. Longer bodies are stored truncated with a marker.
Base URL of the Clinical Dictation Service on Server 2. Server-to-server only; never reachable from a browser.

Shared secret proving a relayed dictation genuinely came from this OpenMRS instance. Must match STT_CHANNEL_SECRET on the dictation service, and must be a DIFFERENT value from agentgateway.channelSecret - the dictation service refuses any request presenting the chat's secret, and the microphone button stays hidden while this is empty or identical to it.
Connect/read timeout for the relay call to the dictation service, in milliseconds. A 30-second utterance transcribes in well under a second, so this is a stuck-connection backstop.
RSA private key (base64 PKCS#8) that signs delegated tokens. Generated automatically on first start. Treat it as a credential: anyone holding it can impersonate any user to this module.
RSA public key (base64 X.509) the agent service uses to verify delegated tokens. Generated automatically alongside the private key; safe to copy around.
